youtube.aciklama: The most widely used criterion in the 2019 American Academy of Otolaryngology guideline is a loss of 30 dB or more at three or more consecutive frequencies within 72 hours. According to the guideline, no clear cause is found at presentation in about 90 percent of these losses. The audiologist's role is to document the loss quickly and refer the person to a physician the same day.
